description: Change an existing autoload's path or singleton flag. Pass autoloadPath, singleton or both; errors if neither is given. An omitted field keeps its current value. Use instead of remove_autoload plus add_autoload: one edit, no window where the autoload is missing. No Godot process is used. Returns: autoload { name, path, singleton } read back from project.godot. Errors if autoloadName is not registered, or if the result is a singleton named like a class_name a project script declares.

autoloadName.description: Name of the autoload to update

autoloadPath.description: New path to the script or scene

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

name: update_autoload

path.description: res:// path of the script or scene.

warnings.description: Present only when the scan for a class_name clash could not cover every .gd file, or the script extends a chain that could not be followed to its end, so a clash may remain.
